description: Trust Securities & Brokerage Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 19 October 1993 and is a brokerage house listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, holding a Trading Right Entitlement Certificate and membership of the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange. It is principally engaged in the brokerage of share, stock, equity and debt securities, commodities and other financial instruments, and corporate financial services, and also trades equity and debt securities on its own account. The current sponsors took over the company in 2017.
headOffice: Business & Finance Center, 4th Floor, Suite No. 401, I.I. Chundrigarh Road, Karachi, Pakistan
